rooms.name: Master Bedroom
rooms.notes: South-west placement per Vastu for master bedroom. En-suite with attached bathroom. Natural light via north-facing plot orientation.

rooms.name: Master Bathroom (En-suite)
rooms.notes: En-suite attached to master bedroom. Wet area with natural exhaust provision.

rooms.name: Bedroom 2
rooms.notes: Second bedroom for 2 BHK unit. East-facing preferred for morning light per Vastu.

rooms.name: Common Bathroom
rooms.notes: Common bathroom accessible from Bedroom 2 and living area. Wet area with external exhaust duct.

rooms.name: Living Room
rooms.notes: North-facing living room maximises natural light from site orientation. Opens to balcony.

rooms.name: Dining Room
rooms.notes: Contiguous with kitchen and living room for open-plan contemporary feel.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.notes: South-east corner per Vastu (Agni corner). Cross-ventilation with external exhaust. Utility/wash area adjacent.

rooms.name: Utility / Wash Area
rooms.notes: Service area for washing machine and mop sink. Adjacent to kitchen for plumbing stack consolidation.

rooms.name: Pooja Room
rooms.notes: North-east (Ishan corner) placement per Vastu. Small dedicated prayer niche / room.

rooms.name: Balcony
rooms.notes: North-facing balcony off living room. Provides passive ventilation and outdoor connection. Railing per IS 883 / NBC Part 4.

rooms.name: Entry Lobby / Foyer
rooms.notes: Apartment entry foyer from staircase / lift landing. Transitional buffer zone between public corridor and private living area.

rooms.name: Internal Corridor
rooms.notes: Internal circulation spine linking bedrooms, bathrooms and living zones within the 2 BHK apartment.

response.floor_summary: Floor 2 houses a single 2 BHK apartment with a north-facing living-balcony, open-plan dining-kitchen, master en-suite bedroom, second bedroom with common bathroom, pooja room in the north-east Vastu corner, and a utility-wash area — all organised around an internal corridor from the entry foyer.
